results.pred_sql: SELECT grade_level.id AS grade_level_id, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid) AS INT) AS student_count FROM student_term AS enrollment JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution AS current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN cases AS case_row ON case_row.student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND case_row.deleted_at IS NULL AND case_row.status <> 'COMPLETED' JOIN grade_levels AS grade_level ON grade_level.id = enrollment."GradeLevelID_Onec" WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY grade_level.id ORDER BY student_count DESC, grade_level.id ASC LIMIT 500
